data.comment:
# Comfy Kling O3- Video Edit

Upload a video and a reference image to edit with Kling O3. Generate a professionally edited video with precise subject editing, scene composition, and native audio-visual synchronization. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_kling_o3_video_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Keep the character (the man) and the ornate bird character (covered in jewelry and exquisite details) in the reference video completely unchanged—including their actions, postures, and all decorative details. Replace the original desert background in the video with the background environment from the reference image (the scene with giant trees, castles, and a blue sky). Adjust the lighting and color tone of the man and the ornate bird to match the new background for a natural, cohesive visual effect.
